# 建模步骤
## 数据初步清洗

1. 读取并合并数据
2. 变量重命名：内在能力及其相关变量，包括出生年份、性别等都重命名
3. 年龄数据清洗：去掉非老年人的个体之后9982人
## 内在能力赋值

### 1. 运动
- 2.5米步行速度≥ 1米/秒得1分；
- 重复坐下5次≤12秒得1分；
- 平衡：3个10秒完成2个及以上得1分。
- 满分3分

### 2. 认知
- 情景记忆（基于延迟回忆得分）：0-10分；
- 减7测试：5分；
- 日期、月份、年份和季节：5分；
- 绘画：1分。
- 满分21分 
- 按四分位数分为0、1、2、3四个分数（还是用线性变换）
- 满分3分

### 3. 心理
- CES-D评分为0到9分：得1分；
- 总睡眠时间在5到10.5小时之间，得1分；
- 睡眠质量：一周内睡眠不安的频率0到2天之间得1分。
- 满分3分

### 4.  感官
- 听力回答非常好、好、一般：得1分；
- 视力回答非常好、好、一般：得1分（远和近两项）
- 满分3分

### 5.  活力
- 握力：男性≥ 35kg得1分，女性≥ 25kg得1分；
- FEV：男性≥ 400得1分，女性≥ 290得1分;
- 血红蛋白：男性≥ 120g/L得1分，女性≥ 110g/L得1分。
- 满分3分

## 内在能力筛选
- 根据内在能力计算情况筛选出覆盖内在能力指标100%的个体
- 保存筛选后的数据到一个新的数据框中  

## 自变量筛选与清洗
### 经验手动筛选
1. 导出原始数据
2. 提取原始数据中的变量名和变量标签，作为两个变量，再加上是否纳入和备注导出为csv
3. 每个类型的数据表单独导出一个工作表
4. 进行手动筛选，筛选出需要的变量（主要根据其临床意义和是否可测算进行筛选）
    - 收入算个人，财产算家庭
    - 再去思考一下bracket的意义
    - 所有的yes再核对
    - 给变量列表加上备注，标出这部分变量的类别
    - 没有观察值的直接排除
5. 将筛选后的数据导出
6. 按照手动筛选出的变量名对原始数据进行清洗，去除不需要的变量，保留内在能力相关变量

### 自变量计算
1. 按照纳入的每个指标附属条目计算出每个指标的最终分数（其中仔细考虑NA和非空0值的意义）
2. 将计算的自变量重新命名


### 缺失值变量筛选
1. 如果某个变量缺失值大于20%，则删除该变量
   
### 算法筛选

1. 采用boruta方法进行算法筛选（可boruta方法需要进行筛选，）


### 连续自变量处理
- 标准化
- 缩放和中心化

### 分类变量处理
- 转化为连续变量
- 转化为哑变量
- 标签编码（适合于等级变量）

## 模型选择
1. 多元线性回归
2. 决策树
3. 随机森林
4. 神经网络
5. 支持向量机

## 模型构建
- 数据再采样（resample）

```{r 安装并加载需要的包}
if (!requireNamespace("openxlsx", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("openxlsx")
```

## 读取并合并数据
```{r 读取并合并数据}
files <- list.files("data_raw/2015/self", pattern = "\\.dta$", full.names = TRUE)
data_list <- lapply(files, read_dta)
my_data_raw <- Reduce(function(x, y) {
    merged <- full_join(x, y, by = "ID", suffix = c("", ".dup"))
    dups <- grep("\\.dup$", names(merged), value = TRUE)
    merged <- merged %>% select(-all_of(dups))
    merged
}, data_list)
```

## 年龄数据清洗
```{r 年龄数据清洗}
# 去除实际出生年份和ID出生年份同时缺失的数据
my_data_year_na <- my_data_rename %>%
    filter(!(is.na(actual_birth_year) & is.na(id_birth_year)))

# 计算年龄值
my_data_age <- my_data_year_na %>%
    mutate(age = 2015 - coalesce(actual_birth_year, id_birth_year))

# 年龄清洗
my_data_elder <- my_data_age %>%
    filter(age >= 60)

# 输出现在总共多少人
total_individuals <- nrow(my_data_elder)
print(paste("总共人数:", total_individuals))

my_data_wash <- my_data_elder
```
## 内在能力分数计算
### 运动维度计算
```{r 运动维度计算}
# 计算步行测试时间（无误）
my_data_wash <- my_data_wash %>%
    mutate(
        final_walk_time = case_when(
            walk_time_first == 993 & walk_time_second == 993 ~ 0,
            (is.na(walk_time_first) & is.na(walk_time_second)) | (walk_time_first == 999 & walk_time_second == 999) | (is.na(walk_time_first) & walk_time_second == 999) | (walk_time_first == 999 & is.na(walk_time_second)) ~ case_when(
                rowSums(select(., starts_with("walk_test_reason_")) == 4, na.rm = TRUE) > 0 ~ 0,
                rowSums(select(., starts_with("walk_test_reason_")) == 6, na.rm = TRUE) > 0 ~ 0,
                TRUE ~ NA_real_
            ),
            TRUE ~ case_when(
                walk_test_aid == 1 ~ if_else(2.5 / pmin(walk_time_first, walk_time_second, na.rm = TRUE) >= 1, 1, 0),
                walk_test_aid %in% c(2, 3, 4, 97) ~ 0,
                TRUE ~ NA_real_
            )
        )
    )

# 统计最终步行时间分数不同取值的数量，包括NA
table(my_data_wash$final_walk_time, useNA = "always")

# 计算平衡分数
# 计算双脚半前后站立时间分数（无误）
my_data_wash <- my_data_wash %>%
    mutate(
        final_semi_tandem_time = case_when(
            stand_test_semi_tandem %in% c(993) ~ 0, # 因为存在这个变量为993但是原因没有4和6的情况，所以这种直接赋值为0了，按这个变量优先
            stand_test_semi_tandem %in% c(999, NA) ~ case_when(
                rowSums(select(., starts_with("stand_test_semi_tandem_reason_")) == 4, na.rm = TRUE) > 0 ~ 0,
                rowSums(select(., starts_with("stand_test_semi_tandem_reason_")) == 6, na.rm = TRUE) > 0 ~ 0,
                TRUE ~ NA_real_
            ),
            stand_test_semi_tandem == 1 ~ 1,
            stand_test_semi_tandem == 5 ~ 0,
            TRUE ~ NA_real_
        )
    )


# 统计双脚半前后站立时间分数不同取值的数量，包括NA
table(my_data_wash$final_semi_tandem_time, useNA = "always")


# 计算双脚前后一条线站立时间分数（无误）
my_data_wash <- my_data_wash %>%
    mutate(
        final_tandem_time = case_when(
            stand_test_tandem %in% c(993) ~ 0, # 因为存在这个变量为993但是原因没有4和6的情况，所以这种直接赋值为0了，按这个变量优先
            stand_test_tandem %in% c(999, NA) ~ case_when(
                rowSums(select(., starts_with("stand_test_tandem_reason_")) == 4, na.rm = TRUE) > 0 ~ 0,
                rowSums(select(., starts_with("stand_test_tandem_reason_")) == 6, na.rm = TRUE) > 0 ~ 0,
                TRUE ~ NA_real_
            ),
            stand_test_tandem == 1 ~ 1,
            stand_test_tandem == 5 ~ if_else(stand_test_tandem_time >= 10, 1, 0),
            TRUE ~ NA_real_
        )
    )
# 统计双脚前后一条线站立分数不同取值的数量，包括NA
table(my_data_wash$final_tandem_time, useNA = "always")


# 计算双脚并拢站立时间分数（无误）
my_data_wash <- my_data_wash %>%
    mutate(
        final_feet_together_time = case_when(
            stand_test_feet_together %in% c(993) ~ 0,
            stand_test_feet_together %in% c(999, NA) ~ case_when(
                rowSums(select(., starts_with("stand_test_feet_together_reason_")) == 4, na.rm = TRUE) > 0 ~ 0,
                rowSums(select(., starts_with("stand_test_feet_together_reason_")) == 6, na.rm = TRUE) > 0 ~ 0,
                TRUE ~ NA_real_
            ),
            stand_test_feet_together == 1 ~ 1,
            stand_test_feet_together == 5 ~ 0,
            TRUE ~ NA_real_
        )
    )

# 统计双脚并拢站立分数不同取值的数量，包括NA
table(my_data_wash$final_feet_together_time, useNA = "always")

# 计算最终平衡得分（无误）
my_data_wash <- my_data_wash %>%
    mutate(
        final_balance_score = case_when(
            rowSums(select(., final_semi_tandem_time, final_tandem_time, final_feet_together_time) == 1, na.rm = TRUE) >= 2 ~ 1,
            rowSums(is.na(select(., final_semi_tandem_time, final_tandem_time, final_feet_together_time))) >= 2 ~ NA_real_,
            rowSums(is.na(select(., final_semi_tandem_time, final_tandem_time, final_feet_together_time))) == 1 &
            rowSums(select(., final_semi_tandem_time, final_tandem_time, final_feet_together_time) == 1, na.rm = TRUE) == 1 &
            rowSums(select(., final_semi_tandem_time, final_tandem_time, final_feet_together_time) == 0, na.rm = TRUE) == 1 ~ NA_real_,
            TRUE ~ 0
        )
    )
# 统计最终平衡得分不同取值的数量，包括NA
table(my_data_wash$final_balance_score, useNA = "always")

# 计算坐起测试时间(无误)
my_data_wash <- my_data_wash %>%
    mutate(
        final_sit_stand_time = case_when(
            sit_stand_test_completed %in% c(993) ~ 0,
            sit_stand_test_completed %in% c(999, NA) ~ case_when(
                rowSums(select(., starts_with("sit_stand_test_reason_")) == 4, na.rm = TRUE) > 0 ~ 0,
                rowSums(select(., starts_with("sit_stand_test_reason_")) == 6, na.rm = TRUE) > 0 ~ 0,
                TRUE ~ NA_real_
            ),
            sit_stand_test_completed == 1 ~ case_when(
                sit_stand_test_arm_use == 1 ~ 0,
                sit_stand_test_arm_use == 5 ~ case_when( # 这个地方数据和代码本否是5，但questionare是1，弄了半天
                    sit_stand_test_time <= 12 ~ 1,
                    sit_stand_test_time > 12 ~ 0,
                    TRUE ~ NA_real_
                    ),
                TRUE ~ NA_real_ 
            ),
            sit_stand_test_completed == 5 ~ 0,
            TRUE ~ NA_real_
        )
    )

# 查看起坐测试时间分数不同取值的数量，包括NA
table(my_data_wash$final_sit_stand_time, useNA = "always")

# 计算运动维度总分（无误）
```

```{r 认知维度计算}
            subtraction_tool_use == 1 ~ 0,
            rowSums(is.na(select(., starts_with("subtraction_test_")))) == 5 ~ 0,
            TRUE ~ rowSums(
                cbind(

                if_else(recall_weekday == 1, 1, if_else(recall_weekday == 2, 0, NA_real_)),
                if_else(recall_season == 1, 1, if_else(recall_season == 2, 0, NA_real_))
            ),

        )

# 计算认知维度层次
quantiles <- quantile(my_data_wash$final_cognitive_score, probs = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE)
my_data_wash <- my_data_wash %>%
    mutate(
        cognitive_level = case_when(
            is.na(final_cognitive_score) ~ NA_real_,
            final_cognitive_score <= quantiles[1] ~ 0,
            final_cognitive_score > quantiles[1] & final_cognitive_score <= quantiles[2] ~ 1,
            final_cognitive_score > quantiles[2] & final_cognitive_score <= quantiles[3] ~ 2,
            final_cognitive_score > quantiles[3] ~ 3
        )
    )

# 查看认知维度层次不同取值的数量，包括NA
table(my_data_wash$cognitive_level, useNA = "always")

)
```

```{r 心理维度计算}
        )
    )

# 查看睡眠时间分数不同取值的数量，包括NA

# 计算不良睡眠频率分数（无误）
my_data_wash <- my_data_wash %>%
    mutate(
        final_poor_sleep_score = case_when(
            poor_sleep_frequency %in% c(1, 2) ~ 1,
            poor_sleep_frequency %in% c(3, 4) ~ 0,
            TRUE ~ NA_real_
        )
    )

# 查看不良睡眠频率分数不同取值的数量，包括NA
table(my_data_wash$final_poor_sleep_score, useNA = "always")

# 计算抑郁总分（目前全部NA才算NA，应该一个NA就是NA）
my_data_wash <- my_data_wash %>%
    mutate(
        total_depression_score = if_else(
            rowSums(is.na(select(., starts_with("depression_scale_")))) > 0,
            NA_real_,
            rowSums(
                select(., starts_with("depression_scale_")) %>%
                    mutate_all(~ case_when(
                        . == 1 ~ 0,
                        . == 2 ~ 1,
                        . == 3 ~ 2,
                        . == 4 ~ 3,
                        TRUE ~ 0
                    )) %>%
                    mutate(
                        depression_scale_5 = case_when(
                            depression_scale_5 == 1 ~ 3,
                            depression_scale_5 == 2 ~ 2,
                            depression_scale_5 == 3 ~ 1,
                            depression_scale_5 == 4 ~ 0,
                            TRUE ~ 0
                        ),
                        depression_scale_8 = case_when(
                            depression_scale_8 == 1 ~ 3,
                            depression_scale_8 == 2 ~ 2,
                            depression_scale_8 == 3 ~ 1,
                            depression_scale_8 == 4 ~ 0,
                            TRUE ~ 0
                        )
                    ),
                na.rm = TRUE
            )
        )
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        final_depression_score = case_when(
            is.na(total_depression_score) ~ NA_real_,
            total_depression_score <= 9 ~ 1,
            TRUE ~ 0
        )
    )

# 统计抑郁总分不同取值的数量，包括NA
table(my_data_wash$final_depression_score, useNA = "always")

    )
```

```{r 活力维度计算}
# 计算左手握力分数（无误）
my_data_wash <- my_data_wash %>%

            left_hand_grip_1 == 993 & left_hand_grip_2 == 993 ~ 0,
            (is.na(left_hand_grip_1) & is.na(left_hand_grip_2)) | (left_hand_grip_1 == 999 & left_hand_grip_2 == 999) | (is.na(left_hand_grip_1) & left_hand_grip_2 == 999) | (left_hand_grip_1 == 999 & is.na(left_hand_grip_2)) ~ case_when(
                rowSums(select(., starts_with("grip_test_reason_")) == 4, na.rm = TRUE) > 0 ~ 0,
                rowSums(select(., starts_with("grip_test_reason_")) == 6, na.rm = TRUE) > 0 ~ 0,
                TRUE ~ NA_real_
            ),
            TRUE ~ pmax(left_hand_grip_1, left_hand_grip_2, na.rm = TRUE)
        )
    )

# 计算右手握力分数（无误）
my_data_wash <- my_data_wash %>%
    mutate(
        final_right_hand_grip = case_when(
            right_hand_grip_1 == 993 & right_hand_grip_2 == 993 ~ 0,
            (is.na(right_hand_grip_1) & is.na(right_hand_grip_2)) | (right_hand_grip_1 == 999 & right_hand_grip_2 == 999) | (is.na(right_hand_grip_1) & right_hand_grip_2 == 999) | (right_hand_grip_1 == 999 & is.na(right_hand_grip_2)) ~ case_when(
                rowSums(select(., starts_with("grip_test_reason_")) == 4, na.rm = TRUE) > 0 ~ 0,
                rowSums(select(., starts_with("grip_test_reason_")) == 6, na.rm = TRUE) > 0 ~ 0,
                TRUE ~ NA_real_
            ),
            TRUE ~ pmax(right_hand_grip_1, right_hand_grip_2, na.rm = TRUE)
        )
    )

my_data_wash <- my_data_wash %>%
    mutate(
        final_grip_score = case_when(
            gender == 1 ~ if_else(pmax(final_left_hand_grip, final_right_hand_grip, na.rm = TRUE) >= 35, 1, 0),
            gender == 2 ~ if_else(pmax(final_left_hand_grip, final_right_hand_grip, na.rm = TRUE) >= 25, 1, 0),

                rowSums(select(., starts_with("breath_test_reason_")) == 4, na.rm = TRUE) > 0 ~ 0,
```

```{r 内在能力清洗}
# 统计覆盖80%内在能力变量的个体
```

```{r 自变量及其标签导出}
# 提取出原始数据中所有变量标签
variable_labels <- sapply(my_data_raw, function(x) attr(x, "label"))
# 将 NULL 元素替换为空字符串
variable_labels[sapply(variable_labels, is.null)] <- ""
# 将变量标签转换为字符向量
variable_labels_values <- unlist(variable_labels)
# 导出变量标签
variable_labels <- data.frame(
    variable = names(my_data_raw),

)
# 创建一个新的Excel工作簿
wb <- createWorkbook()
```

### 人口统计学学数据计算（完成）
```{r 人口学数据计算}
# 查看手动筛选数据中有多少个观察值
nrow(my_data_manual_filtered)

# 读取2011年和2013年人口学数据
demo_2013 <- read_dta("data_raw/2013/self/Demographic_Background.dta")
demo_2011 <- read_dta("data_raw/2011/self/demographic_background.dta")

# 转换2011年数据中的ID变量
demo_2011 <- demo_2011 %>%
    mutate(
        # 创建新的ID变量
        ID = paste0(
            householdID,  # 使用householdID
            "0",          # 添加"0"
            substr(as.character(ID), nchar(as.character(ID))-1, nchar(as.character(ID)))  # 获取原ID的最后两位
        )
    )

# 从2011年数据中选择匹配的观察值
demo_matched_2011 <- demo_2011 %>%
    filter(ID %in% my_data_manual_filtered$ID)

# 从2013年数据中选择匹配的观察值
demo_matched_2013 <- demo_2013 %>%
    filter(ID %in% my_data_manual_filtered$ID)
nrow(demo_matched_2013)

# 计算户口ID（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        householdID = my_data_manual_filtered$householdID
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$householdID, "label") <- "户口ID"

# 计算社区ID（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        communityID = my_data_manual_filtered$communityID
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$communityID, "label") <- "社区ID"

# 计算性别（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        gender = my_data_manual_filtered$xrgender
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$gender, "label") <- "性别"

# 计算居住类型（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        address_type = case_when(
            is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$bb001_w3_1) ~ NA_real_,
            my_data_manual_filtered$bb001_w3_1 == 1 ~ 1,  # 城市住宅
            my_data_manual_filtered$bb001_w3_1 == 2 ~ 2,  # 农村住宅
            my_data_manual_filtered$bb001_w3_1 == 3 ~ 3,  # 养老院/疗养院
            my_data_manual_filtered$bb001_w3_1 == 4 ~ 4,  # 其他
            TRUE ~ NA_real_
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$address_type, "label") <- "居住类型"



# 计算城乡地址（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        address_urban_or_rural = case_when(
            is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$bb001_w3_2) ~ NA_real_,
            my_data_manual_filtered$bb001_w3_2 == 1 ~ 1,  # 主城区
            my_data_manual_filtered$bb001_w3_2 == 2 ~ 2,  # 城乡结合部
            my_data_manual_filtered$bb001_w3_2 == 3 ~ 3,  # 镇中心
            my_data_manual_filtered$bb001_w3_2 == 4 ~ 4,  # 镇乡
            my_data_manual_filtered$bb001_w3_2 == 5 ~ 5,  # 特殊区域
            my_data_manual_filtered$bb001_w3_2 == 6 ~ 6,  # 乡中心
            my_data_manual_filtered$bb001_w3_2 == 7 ~ 7,  # 村庄
            TRUE ~ NA_real_
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$address_urban_or_rural, "label") <- "城乡地址"

# 计算省份（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        address_province = case_when(
            is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$bb001_w3) ~ NA_real_,
            TRUE ~ my_data_manual_filtered$bb001_w3
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$address_province, "label") <- "省份"

# 计算婚姻状况（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        martial_status = case_when(
            is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$be001) ~ NA_real_,
            my_data_manual_filtered$be001 == 1 ~ 1,  # 已婚与配偶一同居住
            my_data_manual_filtered$be001 == 2 ~ 2,  # 已婚但配偶暂时不在一起居住
            my_data_manual_filtered$be001 == 3 ~ 3,  # 已婚但配偶在外地工作
            my_data_manual_filtered$be001 == 4 ~ 4,  # 离异
            my_data_manual_filtered$be001 == 5 ~ 5,  # 丧偶
            my_data_manual_filtered$be001 == 6 ~ 6,  # 从未结婚
            my_data_manual_filtered$be001 == 7 ~ 7,  # 同居
            TRUE ~ NA_real_
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$martial_status, "label") <- "婚姻状况"

# 计算教育水平（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        education_level = case_when(
            # 处理bd011为1/2/3且bd001_w2_4<7的情况
            my_data_manual_filtered$bd011 == 1 & !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$bd001_w2_4) & my_data_manual_filtered$bd001_w2_4 < 7 ~ 7,
            my_data_manual_filtered$bd011 == 2 & !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$bd001_w2_4) & my_data_manual_filtered$bd001_w2_4 < 7 ~ 8,
            my_data_manual_filtered$bd011 == 3 & !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$bd001_w2_4) & my_data_manual_filtered$bd001_w2_4 < 7 ~ 9,
            
            # 处理bd011为4或NA，且bd001_w2_4为NA的情况
            (my_data_manual_filtered$bd011 == 4 | is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$bd011)) & is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$bd001_w2_4) ~ NA_real_,
            
            # 处理bd011为NA，且bd001_w2_4不为12的情况
            is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$bd011) & !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$bd001_w2_4) & my_data_manual_filtered$bd001_w2_4 != 12 ~ as.numeric(my_data_manual_filtered$bd001_w2_4),
            
            # 处理bd011为NA，且bd001_w2_4为12的情况
            is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$bd011) & my_data_manual_filtered$bd001_w2_4 == 12 ~ case_when(
                # 检查2013年数据
                ID %in% demo_matched_2013$ID & !is.na(demo_matched_2013$bd001_w2_4[match(ID, demo_matched_2013$ID)]) & 
                demo_matched_2013$bd001_w2_4[match(ID, demo_matched_2013$ID)] != 12 ~ 
                as.numeric(demo_matched_2013$bd001_w2_4[match(ID, demo_matched_2013$ID)]),
                
                # 如果2013年数据不满足条件，检查2011年数据
                ID %in% demo_matched_2011$ID & !is.na(demo_matched_2011$bd001[match(ID, demo_matched_2011$ID)]) ~ 
                as.numeric(demo_matched_2011$bd001[match(ID, demo_matched_2011$ID)]),
                
                # 如果都不满足，返回NA
                TRUE ~ NA_real_
            ),
            
            # 其他情况返回NA
            TRUE ~ NA_real_
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$education_level, "label") <- "教育水平"

# 计算是否识字（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        literate = case_when(
            # 如果教育水平大于3
            education_level > 3 ~ 1,
            # 如果教育水平为2或3
            education_level %in% c(2, 3) ~ 1,
            # 如果教育水平为1，则根据bd001_w3_1判断
            education_level == 1 ~ case_when(
                my_data_manual_filtered$bd001_w3_1 == 1 ~ 1,
                TRUE ~ 0
            ),
            # 其他情况
            TRUE ~ NA_real_
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$literate, "label") <- "是否识字"

# 导出人口学数据
demographic_data <- my_data_calculated %>%
    select(ID, householdID, communityID, gender, address_type, address_urban_or_rural, address_province, literate, martial_status, education_level, age)
# 导出人口学数据为parquet
write_parquet(demographic_data, "data_export/data_calculated/parquet/data_calculated_demographic.parquet")
# 导出人口学数据为csv
write.csv(demographic_data, "data_export/data_calculated/csv/data_calculated_demographic.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

### 家庭结构计算（完成）
```{r 家庭结构计算}
# 计算亲生父母是否健在（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        biological_parents_alive = case_when(
            # 如果两个变量都是NA，返回NA
            is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$ca000_w3_2_1_) & 
            is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$ca001_w3_2_1_) ~ NA_real_,
            # 否则计算非NA值的总和
            TRUE ~ rowSums(
                select(my_data_manual_filtered, ca000_w3_2_1_, ca001_w3_2_1_) %>%
                mutate_all(~case_when(
                    . == 1 ~ 1,  # 取值为1记为1
                    . == 2 ~ 0,  # 取值为2记为0
                    TRUE ~ NA_real_  # 其他值记为NA
                )),
                na.rm = TRUE  # 忽略NA值
            )
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$biological_parents_alive, "label") <- "亲生父母健在数量"
table(my_data_calculated$biological_parents_alive, useNA = "ifany")

# 计算配偶亲生父母健在数量（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        spouse_biological_parents_alive = case_when(
            # 如果两个变量都是NA，返回NA
            is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$ca000_w3_2_2_) & 
            is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$ca001_w3_2_2_) ~ NA_real_,
            # 否则计算非NA值的总和
            TRUE ~ rowSums(
                select(my_data_manual_filtered, ca000_w3_2_2_, ca001_w3_2_2_) %>%
                mutate_all(~case_when(
                    . == 1 ~ 1,  # 取值为1记为1
                    . == 2 ~ 0,  # 取值为2记为0
                    TRUE ~ NA_real_  # 其他值记为NA
                )),
                na.rm = TRUE  # 忽略NA值
            )
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$spouse_biological_parents_alive, "label") <- "配偶亲生父母健在数量"

# 计算父母是否离异（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        parents_divorced = case_when(
            my_data_manual_filtered$ca002_w3_1_1_ == 1 ~ 1,
            my_data_manual_filtered$ca002_w3_1_1_ == 2 ~ 0,
            TRUE ~ NA_real_
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$parents_divorced, "label") <- "父母是否离异"

# 计算子女总数（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        num_children = my_data_manual_filtered$xchildnum
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$num_children, "label") <- "子女总数"

# 计算健在子女数量（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        totalnum_children_alive = case_when(
            is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$xchildnum_alive) & is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cb051_w3_1) ~ NA_real_,
            TRUE ~ coalesce(my_data_manual_filtered$xchildnum_alive, 0) + coalesce(my_data_manual_filtered$cb051_w3_1, 0)
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$totalnum_children_alive, "label") <- "健在子女数量"

# 计算去世子女数量（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        num_children_dead = case_when(
            is.na(num_children) | is.na(totalnum_children_alive) ~ NA_real_,
            TRUE ~ num_children - totalnum_children_alive
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$num_children_dead, "label") <- "死亡子女数量"

# 计算死亡子女比例
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        dead_children_ratio = case_when(
            is.na(num_children_dead) | is.na(totalnum_children_alive) ~ NA_real_,
            num_children == 0 ~ 0,
            TRUE ~ num_children_dead / totalnum_children_alive
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$dead_children_ratio, "label") <- "死亡子女比例"

# 计算已婚子女数量及比例（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        num_children_married = case_when(
            # 检查是否所有值都是NA
            all(is.na(select(my_data_manual_filtered, starts_with("cb063_")))) ~ NA_real_,
            # 否则计算非NA值的总和
            TRUE ~ rowSums(
                select(my_data_manual_filtered, starts_with("cb063_")) %>%
                mutate_all(~case_when(
                    . == 1 ~ 1,  # 已婚记为1
                    !is.na(.) ~ 0,  # 其他非NA值记为0
                    TRUE ~ NA_real_  # NA保持为NA
                )),
                na.rm = TRUE  # 忽略部分NA值
            )
        ),
        married_children_ratio = case_when(
            is.na(num_children_married) | is.na(totalnum_children_alive) ~ NA_real_,
            totalnum_children_alive == 0 ~ 0,
            TRUE ~ num_children_married / totalnum_children_alive
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$married_children_ratio, "label") <- "已婚子女比例"

# 计算孙子女数量（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        total_number_grandchildren = case_when(
            # 检查是否所有值都是NA
            all(is.na(select(my_data_manual_filtered, starts_with("cb065_")))) ~ NA_real_,
            # 否则计算非NA值的总和
            TRUE ~ rowSums(
                select(my_data_manual_filtered, starts_with("cb065_")) %>%
                mutate_all(as.numeric),
                na.rm = TRUE  # 忽略部分NA值
            )
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$total_number_grandchildren, "label") <- "孙子女总数"

# 计算重孙子女数量（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        total_number_great_grandchildren = case_when(
            # 检查是否所有值都是NA
            all(is.na(select(my_data_manual_filtered, starts_with("cb067_")))) ~ NA_real_,
            # 否则计算非NA值的总和
            TRUE ~ rowSums(
                select(my_data_manual_filtered, starts_with("cb067_")) %>%
                mutate_all(as.numeric),
                na.rm = TRUE  # 忽略部分NA值
            )
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$total_number_great_grandchildren, "label") <- "重孙子女总数"

# 导出家庭结构数据
# 选择家庭结构变量
family_structure_data <- my_data_calculated %>%
    select(
        ID, biological_parents_alive, spouse_biological_parents_alive, 
        parents_divorced, num_children, totalnum_children_alive,
        num_children_dead, dead_children_ratio, 
        num_children_married, married_children_ratio,
        total_number_grandchildren, total_number_great_grandchildren
    )
# 导出家庭结构数据为parquet
write_parquet(family_structure_data, "data_export/data_calculated/parquet/data_calculated_family_structure.parquet")
# 导出家庭结构数据为csv
write.csv(family_structure_data, "data_export/data_calculated/csv/data_calculated_family_structure.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r 照顾负担计算}
# 计算照顾父母数量（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%

            # 否则计算非NA值的总和
            TRUE ~ rowSums(
                select(my_data_manual_filtered, starts_with("ca026_w3_")) %>%
                mutate_all(~case_when(
                    . == 1 ~ 0,  # yes记为0
                    . == 2 ~ 1,   # no记为1
                    TRUE ~ NA_real_  # 其他值记为NA
                )),
                na.rm = TRUE  # 忽略部分NA值
            )
        )

my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        number_takecare_children = case_when(
            # 检查是否所有值都是NA
            all(is.na(select(my_data_manual_filtered, starts_with("cb063_w3_6_")))) ~ NA_real_,
            # 否则计算非NA值的总和
            TRUE ~ rowSums(
                select(my_data_manual_filtered, starts_with("cb063_w3_6_")) %>%
                mutate_all(~case_when(
                    . == 1 ~ 0,  # yes记为0
                    . == 2 ~ 1,  # no记为1
                    TRUE ~ NA_real_  # 其他值记为NA
                )),
                na.rm = TRUE  # 忽略部分NA值
            )
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$number_takecare_children, "label") <- "照顾子女数量"

# 计算是否带孙子女（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        takecare_grandchildren = case_when(
            is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf001) ~ NA_real_,
            my_data_manual_filtered$cf001 == 1 ~ 1,  # yes记为1
            my_data_manual_filtered$cf001 == 2 ~ 0,  # no记为0
            TRUE ~ NA_real_  # 其他值记为NA
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$takecare_grandchildren, "label") <- "是否照顾孙子女"

# 计算照顾孙子女总小时数（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        takecare_grandchildren_hours = case_when(
            # 首先判断是否照顾孙子女
            takecare_grandchildren == 0 ~ 0,
            takecare_grandchildren == 1 ~ case_when(
                # 如果两个数值相乘的结果都是NA，则返回NA
                all(
                    (is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_1_) | is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_1_)) &
                    (is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_2_) | is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_2_)) &
                    (is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_3_) | is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_3_)) &
                    (is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_4_) | is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_4_)) &
                    (is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_5_) | is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_5_)) &
                    (is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_6_) | is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_6_)) &
                    (is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_7_) | is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_7_)) &
                    (is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_8_) | is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_8_)) &
                    (is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_9_) | is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_9_)) &
                    (is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_10_) | is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_10_)) &
                    (is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_11_) | is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_11_)) &
                    (is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_13_) | is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_13_))
                ) ~ NA_real_,
                # 否则计算乘积
                TRUE ~ rowSums(
                    cbind(
                        my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_1_ * my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_1_,
                        my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_2_ * my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_2_,
                        my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_3_ * my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_3_,
                        my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_4_ * my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_4_,
                        my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_5_ * my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_5_,
                        my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_6_ * my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_6_,
                        my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_7_ * my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_7_,
                        my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_8_ * my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_8_,
                        my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_9_ * my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_9_,
                        my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_10_ * my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_10_,
                        my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_11_ * my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_11_,
                        my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_2_13_ * my_data_manual_filtered$cf003_1_13_),
                    na.rm = TRUE
                )
            ),
            # 如果takecare_grandchildren是NA，返回NA
            is.na(takecare_grandchildren) ~ NA_real_
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$takecare_grandchildren_hours, "label") <- "照顾孙子女总小时数"

# 计算是否照顾父母（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        takecare_parents = case_when(
            is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf004) ~ NA_real_,
            my_data_manual_filtered$cf004 == 1 ~ 1,  # yes记为1
            my_data_manual_filtered$cf004 == 2 ~ 0,  # no记为0
            TRUE ~ NA_real_  # 其他值记为NA
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$takecare_parents, "label") <- "是否照顾父母"

# 计算照顾父母总小时数（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        takecare_parents_hours = case_when(
            # 如果不照顾父母，时间为0
            takecare_parents == 0 ~ 0,
            # 如果照顾父母，计算照顾时间
            takecare_parents == 1 ~ case_when(
                # 检查是否所有相关变量都是NA
                all(
                    (is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf005_1) | is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf005_2)) &
                    (is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf005_3) | is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf005_4)) &
                    (is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf005_5) | is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf005_6)) &
                    (is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf005_7) | is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$cf005_8))
                ) ~ NA_real_,
                # 否则计算照顾父母的总时间
                TRUE ~ rowSums(
                    cbind(
                        my_data_manual_filtered$cf005_1 * my_data_manual_filtered$cf005_2,
                        my_data_manual_filtered$cf005_3 * my_data_manual_filtered$cf005_4,
                        my_data_manual_filtered$cf005_5 * my_data_manual_filtered$cf005_6,
                        my_data_manual_filtered$cf005_7 * my_data_manual_filtered$cf005_8
                    ),
                    na.rm = TRUE  # 忽略部分NA值
                )
            ),
            # 如果takecare_parents是NA，返回NA
            TRUE ~ NA_real_
        )
    )
attr(my_data_calculated$takecare_parents_hours, "label") <- "照顾父母总小时数"

# 导出照顾负担数据
# 导出照顾负担相关数据
caregiving_burden_data <- my_data_calculated %>%
    select(
        ID,                             # ID
        number_care_parents,            # 照顾父母数量
        number_takecare_children,       # 照顾子女数量
        takecare_grandchildren,         # 是否照顾孙子女
        takecare_grandchildren_hours,   # 照顾孙子女总小时数
        takecare_parents,               # 是否照顾父母
        takecare_parents_hours         # 照顾父母总小时数
    )

# 导出照顾负担数据为parquet格式
write_parquet(caregiving_burden_data, "data_export/data_calculated/parquet/data_calculated_caregiving_burden.parquet")
# 导出照顾负担数据为csv格式
write.csv(caregiving_burden_data, "data_export/data_calculated/csv/data_calculated_caregiving_burden.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r 疾病情况计算}
# 计算癌症总数（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        number_cancer = case_when(
            # 如果所有癌症变量都是NA，返回NA
            is.na(cancer_brain) & 
            is.na(cancer_mouth) & 
            is.na(cancer_larynx) & 
            is.na(cancer_pharynx) & 
            is.na(cancer_thyroid) & 
            is.na(cancer_lung) & 
            is.na(cancer_breast) & 
            is.na(cancer_esophagus) & 
            is.na(cancer_stomach) & 
            is.na(cancer_liver) & 
            is.na(cancer_pancreas) & 
            is.na(cancer_kidney) & 
            is.na(cancer_prostate) & 
            is.na(cancer_testis) & 
            is.na(cancer_ovary) & 
            is.na(cancer_cervix) & 
            is.na(cancer_endometrium) & 
            is.na(cancer_colorectal) & 
            is.na(cancer_bladder) & 
            is.na(cancer_skin) & 
            is.na(cancer_non_hodgkin_lymphoma) & 
            is.na(cancer_leukemia) & 
            is.na(cancer_other) ~ NA_real_,
            # 否则计算非NA值的总和
            TRUE ~ rowSums(
                select(., cancer_brain, cancer_mouth, cancer_larynx,
                       cancer_pharynx, cancer_thyroid, cancer_lung,
                       cancer_breast, cancer_esophagus, cancer_stomach,
                       cancer_liver, cancer_pancreas, cancer_kidney,
                       cancer_prostate, cancer_testis, cancer_ovary,
                       cancer_cervix, cancer_endometrium, cancer_colorectal,
                       cancer_bladder, cancer_skin, cancer_non_hodgkin_lymphoma,
                       cancer_leukemia, cancer_other),
                na.rm = TRUE
            )
        )
    )

                my_data_manual_filtered$da029 == 1 | my_data_manual_filtered$da029_w2_1 == 1 ~ 1,  # 任一为1则记为1
                (my_data_manual_filtered$da029 == 2 & my_data_manual_filtered$da029_w2_1 != 1) |
                (my_data_manual_filtered$da029_w2_1 == 2 & my_data_manual_filtered$da029 != 1) ~ 0,  # 一个是2另一个不是1则记为0

            prostate_illness == 1 ~ case_when(

            # 如果任一变量为1，返回1
            my_data_manual_filtered$zda035 == 1 |
            my_data_manual_filtered$da035 == 1 ~ 1,
            # 如果任一变量为2，且另一个不为1，返回0
            (my_data_manual_filtered$zda035 == 2 & 
             (is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da035) | 
              my_data_manual_filtered$da035 != 1)) |
            (my_data_manual_filtered$da035 == 2 & 
             (is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$zda035) |

            # 其他情况返回NA

# 计算是否无牙（没问题）
my_data_calculated <- my_data_calculated %>%
    mutate(
        noteeth = case_when(
            # 如果zda040和da040都是NA，返回NA
            is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$zda040) & 
            is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da040) ~ NA_real_,
            # 如果任一变量为1，返回1
            my_data_manual_filtered$zda040 == 1 |
            my_data_manual_filtered$da040 == 1 ~ 1,
            # 如果任一变量为2，且另一个不为1，返回0
            (my_data_manual_filtered$zda040 == 2 & 
             (is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da040) | 
              my_data_manual_filtered$da040 != 1)) |
            (my_data_manual_filtered$da040 == 2 & 
             (is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$zda040) | 
              my_data_manual_filtered$zda040 != 1)) ~ 0,
            # 其他情况返回NA
            TRUE ~ NA_real_
        )
    )

        number_pain_locations = case_when(

            is.na(pain_head) & is.na(pain_shoulder) & is.na(pain_arm) & 
            is.na(pain_wrist) & is.na(pain_fingers) & is.na(pain_chest) & 
            is.na(pain_stomach) & is.na(pain_back) & is.na(pain_waist) & 
            is.na(pain_buttocks) & is.na(pain_leg) & is.na(pain_knees) & 
            is.na(pain_ankle) & is.na(pain_toes) & is.na(pain_neck) & 
            is.na(pain_other) ~ NA_real_,
            # 否则计算非NA值的总和
            TRUE ~ rowSums(
                select(., starts_with("pain_")),
                na.rm = TRUE
            )
        )

            pain == 1 ~ case_when(  # 如果有疼痛，则继续判断
                # 如果所有治疗相关变量都是NA，返回2
                all(is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da042_w2_1s1),
                    is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da042_w2_1s2),
                    is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da042_w2_1s3),
                    is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da042_w2_1s4),
                    is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da042_w2_1s5),
                    is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da042_w2_1s6)) ~ 2,
                # 如果任一治疗变量为1，返回1
                !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da042_w2_1s1) |
                !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da042_w2_1s2) |
                !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da042_w2_1s3) |
                !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da042_w2_1s4) |
                !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da042_w2_1s5) |
                !is.na(my_data_manual_filtered$da042_w2_1s6) ~ 1,
                # 其他情况返回0
                TRUE ~ 0
            ),
            TRUE ~ NA_real_  # 其他情况返回NA
        )
    )

    select(

        physical_disability, intellectual_disability,
        blind_partially_blind, deaf_partially_deaf,
        dumb_severe_stuttering, number_disability,
        year_physical_disability, year_intellectual_disability,
        year_blind_partially_blind, year_deaf_partially_deaf,
        year_dumb_severe_stuttering,
        # 疾病及治疗情况
        hypertension, treat_hypertension,
        dyslipidemia, treat_dyslipidemia,
        diabetes, treat_diabetes,
        cancer, treat_cancer,
        chronic_lung_disease, treat_chronic_lung_disease,
        liver_disease, treat_liver_disease,
        heart_disease, treat_heart_disease,
        stroke, treat_stroke,
        kidney_disease, treat_kidney_disease,
        digestive_system_disease, treat_digestive_system_disease,
        emotional_and_mental_issues, treat_emotional_and_mental_issues,
        diseases_related_to_memory, treat_diseases_related_to_memory,
        diseases_arthritis, treat_diseases_arthritis,
        asthma,number_chronic_disease, 
        
        # 疾病年份
        year_hypertension, year_dyslipidemia, year_diabetes,
        year_cancer, year_chronic_lung_disease, year_liver_disease,
        year_heart_disease, year_stroke, year_kidney_disease,
        year_digestive_system_disease, year_emotional_and_mental_issues,
        year_diseases_related_to_memory, year_diseases_arthritis,
        year_asthma,
        
        # 健康状况和控制情况
        health_compared, control_hypertension, control_diabetes,
        times_exam_bp, exam_bp, blood_glucose_test, blood_glucose_test_often,
        
        # 心脏病相关
        heart_attack, heart_attack_year,
        
        # 癌症类型
        cancer_brain, cancer_mouth, cancer_larynx, cancer_pharynx,
        cancer_thyroid, cancer_lung, cancer_breast, cancer_esophagus,
        cancer_stomach, cancer_liver, cancer_pancreas, cancer_kidney,
        cancer_prostate, cancer_testis, cancer_ovary, cancer_cervix,
        cancer_endometrium, cancer_colorectal, cancer_bladder,
        cancer_skin, cancer_non_hodgkin_lymphoma, cancer_leukemia,
        cancer_other, number_cancer,
        
        # 伤害和事故
        traffic_accident_major_accidental_injury,
        injury_limit_daily_activities, fallen_down, times_fallen_down,
        fractured_hip,
        
        # 特定健康状况
        menopause, prostate_illness, prostate_illness_age,
        treat_prostate_illness, cataract_surgery, treat_glaucoma,
        noteeth, glaucoma, re_glaucoma,
        
        # 疼痛相关
        pain, pain_head, pain_shoulder, pain_arm,
        pain_wrist, pain_fingers, pain_chest, pain_stomach,
        pain_back, pain_waist, pain_buttocks, pain_leg,
        pain_knees, pain_ankle, pain_toes, pain_neck,
        pain_other, number_pain_locations, treat_pain,
        # 其他疾病
        others_diseases
    )

# 导出疾病情况相关数据为parquet
write_parquet(disease_data, "data_export/data_calculated/parquet/data_calculated_disease.parquet")

# 导出疾病情况相关数据为csv
write.csv(disease_data, "data_export/data_calculated/csv/data_calculated_disease.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r 行为习惯计算}
                my_data_manual_filtered$da054_1_ == 2 ~ 3,
                my_data_manual_filtered$da053_1_ == 2 ~ 2,

        high_exercise, moderate_exercise, low_exercise,
        
        # 社交相关
        number_social_activities, social_isolation,
        internet_use, devices_internet_use,
        frequency_social_activities,
        
        # 吸烟相关
        smoke, type_smoke_pipe, type_smoke_self_rolled_cigarette,
        type_smoke_filtered_cigarette, type_smoke_unfiltered_cigarette,
        type_smoke_cigar, type_smoke_water_cigarette,
        status_smoke, number_smoke, year_smoke,
        
        # 饮酒相关
        drink, type_drink_liqor, type_drink_beer, type_drink_wine,
        drink_status, year_drink,
        frequency_drink_liquor, frequency_drink_beer, frequency_drink_wine,
        much_drink_liquor, much_drink_beer, much_drink_wine
    )

# 导出行为习惯相关数据为csv
```

## 缺失值筛选
```{r 缺失值筛选及处理}
# 去除缺失值超过20%的变量
my_data_na_filtered <- preprocessed_data %>%
    select_if(~sum(is.na(.)) / nrow(preprocessed_data) <= 0.2)

# 查看缺失值筛选后的数据框的维度
dim(my_data_na_filtered)

# 加载mice包
library(mice)

# 对连续变量进行mice插补
continuous_vars <- my_data_na_filtered %>%
    select_if(is.numeric)

imputed_continuous <- mice(continuous_vars, method = 'pmm', m = 5, maxit = 10, seed = 500)

# 用插补后的数据替换原始数据
my_data_na_filtered[ , names(continuous_vars)] <- complete(imputed_continuous)

# 对分类变量进行众数插补
categorical_vars <- my_data_na_filtered %>%
    select_if(is.factor)

mode_impute <- function(x) {
    ux <- unique(x)
    ux[which.max(tabulate(match(x, ux)))]
}

my_data_na_filtered[ , names(categorical_vars)] <- lapply(categorical_vars, function(x) {
    x[is.na(x)] <- mode_impute(x)
    return(x)
})

# 查看插补后的数据框的维度
dim(my_data_na_filtered)


# 导出缺失值筛选后的数据框
write_parquet(my_data_na_filtered, "data_export/data_calculated/my_data_na_filtered.parquet")


```
## 算法筛选
```{r Boruta算法筛选}
# 使用Boruta算法进行变量筛选（Boruta方法应该用在缺失值处理之后还是之前）
set.seed(123)

# 检查因子变量的水平数量
single_level_factors <- sapply(my_data_na_filtered, function(x) {
  if (is.factor(x)) length(levels(x)) == 1 else FALSE
})

# 打印只有一个水平的因子变量
print(names(single_level_factors[single_level_factors]))

# 移除只有一个水平的因子变量
my_data_na_filtered <- my_data_na_filtered %>%
  select(-all_of(names(single_level_factors[single_level_factors])))
dim(my_data_na_filtered)

variable_names <- names(my_data_na_filtered)
print(variable_names)

# 准备数据
x <- model.matrix(ic_total_score ~ ., my_data_na_filtered)[,-1]
y <- my_data_na_filtered$ic_total_score

# 运行Boruta算法
boruta.out <- Boruta(x, y, doTrace = 2)

# 获取确定纳入的变量
confirmed_vars <- names(boruta.out$finalDecision[boruta.out$finalDecision == "Confirmed"])
print("确定纳入的变量:")
print(confirmed_vars)

# 选出建模需要的数据
model_data <- my_data_na_filtered %>%
    select(
        gender, age, address_urban_or_rural, martial_status, education_level, literate, height, weight, bmi, waist_circumference, hematocrit, creatinine, cystatin_c, num_children_married, total_number_grandchildren, total_number_great_grandchildren, payfor_inpatientcare_pastyear, deaf_partially_deaf, number_disability, year_deaf_partially_deaf, number_chronic_disease, treat_chronic_lung_disease, year_chronic_lung_disease, health_compared, menopause, pain, pain_head, pain_shoulder, pain_arm, pain_wrist, pain_fingers, pain_chest, pain_back, pain_waist, pain_leg, pain_knees, pain_ankle, pain_toes, pain_neck, number_pain_locations, treat_pain, function1, iadl_total, health_satisfaction, life_satisfaction, number_social_activities, number_smoke, ic_total_score
    )

# 查看提取后的数据框的维度
dim(model_data)

# 导出提取后的数据框
write_parquet(model_data, "data_export/data_calculated/model_data.parquet")
write.csv(model_data, "data_export/data_calculated/model_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

## 建模及验证
```{r 建模及验证}
# 检查并安装所需的R包
required_packages <- c("glmnet", "caret", "vip", "recipes", "rsample", "ggplot2")
if (!require(randomForest)) install.packages("randomForest")

# 检查哪些包没有安装
new_packages <- required_packages[!(required_packages %in% installed.packages()[,"Package"])]

# 如果有未安装的包，则安装它们
if(length(new_packages)) install.packages(new_packages)

# 加载所需的包
library(glmnet)  
library(caret)   
library(vip)
library(recipes)
library(rsample)
library(ggplot2)
library(caret)
library(randomForest)

# 数据拆分
set.seed(123)
split <- initial_split(model_data, prop = 0.7) # 是否需要分层抽样？
ic_train  <- training(split)
ic_test   <- testing(split)

# 特征工程
blueprint <- recipe(ic_total_score ~ ., data = model_data) %>%
  step_nzv(all_nominal()) %>%
  step_integer(matches("Qual|Cond|QC|Qu")) %>%
  step_center(all_numeric(), -all_outcomes()) %>%
  step_scale(all_numeric(), -all_outcomes()) %>%
  step_dummy(all_nominal(), -all_outcomes()) %>%
  step_impute_knn(all_predictors(), neighbors = 6)

# 确定交叉验证方法
cv <- trainControl(
  method = "repeatedcv", 
  number = 10, 
  repeats = 5
)

# 构建KNN模型
hyper_grid <- expand.grid(k = seq(2, 25, by = 1))

# 调试KNN模型
knn_fit <- train(
  blueprint, 
  data = ic_train, 
  method = "knn", 
  trControl = cv, 
  tuneGrid = hyper_grid,
  metric = "RMSE"
)

# 查看KNN模型的结果
print(knn_fit)

# 查看最佳模型的性能
best_model_performance <- knn_fit$results[knn_fit2$results$k == best_k, ]
print("最佳模型的性能:")
print(best_model_performance)

# 构建随机森林模型
set.seed(123)
rf_fit <- train(
  blueprint,
  data = ic_train, 
  method = "rf", 
  trControl = cv,
  importance = TRUE
)

# 查看模型的重要性
varImpPlot(rf_fit$finalModel)

# 查看模型的性能
print(rf_fit)


```
